title: Attendance Calendar and absence-code form - observed 2023-2024
summary: A restricted employee medical/attendance packet contains 2023 and 2024 versions of a standardized RTEC Attendance Calendar. Only the reusable form structure and printed rules are modeled; handwritten employee entries and medical facts remain restricted.

claims.claim: The Attendance Calendar captures Employee Name, Employee Number, Hire Date, Department, Location and Part Time/Full Time status, then provides a month-by-month calendar with monthly Total Points and a Total Annual Points field.

evidence.page_or_section: 2023 and 2024 Attendance Calendar pages - printed form structure only
evidence.note: Employee-specific entries and identifiers are excluded.

claims.claim: The printed absence-code legend includes: CI Call In; CX Trips cancelled; D Discipline/Suspension; DF Death in Family; FI Family Illness; FM FMLA; F Funeral; H Holiday; J Jury Duty; L Lack of Work; LE Left Early; MA Medical Appointment; NC/NS No Call/No Show; NP No Points; P Personal; S Sick; SO Scheduled off by Manager; T Tardy; UE Unexcused; V Vacation; W Weather; WC Workers Compensation.

evidence.page_or_section: 2023 and 2024 Attendance Calendar - Absence Codes legend

claims.claim: The printed point-assignment legend states: less than 4 hours = 1/4 point; 4 to 6 hours = 1/2 point; 7 or more hours = 1 point.

evidence.page_or_section: 2024 Attendance Calendar - Absentee point assignment legend
evidence.note: The current 2025 handbook uses the same duration bands.

claims.claim: The form states that points are reduced only by an absence-free two-month period or when a point becomes one year old; the form does not print the amount removed for the two-month condition.

evidence.note: Current 2025 handbook clarifies that 60 consecutive days without a point removes one point and each point expires after 365 days.

claims.claim: The December 15, 2025 handbook retains the same partial-day point bands and clarifies the decay rules as one point removed after 60 consecutive point-free days plus 365-day expiration, making the 2023-2024 form a historical predecessor to the current attendance policy.

trigger: HR tracks an employee absence/tardy event and attendance points.
prerequisites: Identify the applicable absence category and whether the event is point-bearing under the governing policy.
steps: Mark absence event using the applicable code.
Assign points using the applicable duration/exclusion rules.
Maintain monthly and annual point totals.
Reduce/expire points under the governing policy.
decisions: Whether the event is point-bearing or excluded/protected.
How many points apply based on duration.
deadlines: Historical form references two-month point-free and one-year age conditions; current policy states 60 consecutive days and 365 days.
exceptions: NP explicitly indicates No Points; FMLA, workers' compensation and other exclusions are governed by policy rather than the calendar alone.
controls: Keep employee-specific attendance and medical details restricted.
Do not rely on handwritten annotations as general policy.
Use the current handbook for current thresholds and exclusions.
unresolved_questions: Is this same calendar template still used after the 2025 handbook update, or has it been replaced by a system-generated attendance record?
automation_candidates: Digitize the attendance calendar into a controlled ledger with code validation, protected-leave exclusions, automatic 60-day/365-day point aging and a human-review audit trail.
Add scanner fingerprints for Attendance Calendar title, absence-code legend and monthly point blocks.

provenance.page_or_section: printed form structure and legends only
provenance.notes: Raw employee marks, identifiers and medical facts are not stored in GitHub.
